move: photo punches in, athlete strides in skewed, type slams up
how: A grayscale, duotone-screened photo eases from scale 1.3 to 1.05 with power2.out across the whole loop under an SVG turbulence grain; a white flash fades out over 0.35s at the start. An SVG runner silhouette from() x:-500 skewX:-20 with expo.out, then leans slowly forward (x:60, scale 1.08, power1.out over 3.1s). Three 300px headline lines snap up from overflow masks (yPercent 115→0 expo.out, stagger 0.1) and the block settles from scaleY 1.08 with elastic.out; a marquee stripe slides in from the left with its text scrolling x:0→-700 linearly for the full D, and the outlined middle word flashes solid white at 0.55D. From 0.85D the lines shove up with expo.in, the athlete sprints off right with skewX 15, the stripe exits and captions fade, then the flash restarts the loop.
adapt: Swap the photo, the duotone gradient colours, the three headline words (mark one .out for the outline flash), stripe text, sub and logo; replace the SVG runner path with your own silhouette. Keep the 1.3→1.05 punch and the expo.out/elastic headline landing.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .photo with img plus .duotone, the grain SVG, .athlete, .headline lines, .stripe, .sub, .logo and .flash, waiting on img load; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with offsets as fractions of D (athlete 0.05/4, headline 0.25/4, outline flash 2.2/4, exit 3.4/4). Scope selectors to el; the SVG filter id must be unique per instance.
caveats: full-frame feTurbulence grain filter and grayscale/contrast filter on the photo are render costs
